body.name: Inclusion-minimal sufficient design frontier
body.construction: \(\mathfrak F(T,S,(|\mathcal X_t|)_{t=1}^T)=\{B:\mathsf C(T,S,B,(|\mathcal X_t|)_{t=1}^T)=1,\;\mathsf C(T,S,B',( |\mathcal X_t|)_{t=1}^T)=0\text{ for every }B'\lneq B\}\), where \(B'\le B\) means \(B'_d\subseteq B_d\) for every \(d<T\).
